title: Code and tutorials for: A general method for estimating reliability using Bayesian Measurement Uncertainty
description: R and Stan code for the simulation studies, applied example and tutorials accompanying the preprint A general method for estimating reliability using Bayesian Measurement Uncertainty (Bignardi, Kievit & Bürkner). Relative measurement uncertainty (RMU) estimates reliability by drawing pairs of samples from each subject's posterior and correlating them. Includes rendered tutorials (HTML and PDF) for go/no-go (signal detection), mean/sum score and reinforcement-learning (bandit) examples. All code runs in the Docker image bignardig/tidyverse461 (R 4.6.1); see README.md.
